facts.business: The Yamuna Syndicate Limited is a trading company engaged in distribution of lubricants (Gulf Oil, ExxonMobil), electrical goods (air conditioners, water heaters), batteries, fuel retail (diesel/petrol pump), and recently PVC pipes, with significant dividend income from its associate Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited.

segments.name: Electrical goods trading (Air Conditioners, water heaters)

capacity_or_capex.item: Associate Company (Isgec Heavy Engineering) manufacturing capacity expansion

guidance_or_targets.statement: Demand for most traded products expected to remain steady; confident of booking share of business
Associate Company's step-down subsidiary commenced commercial production, expected to contribute positively
Associate Company's capacity expansion expected to enhance revenue generation and profitability
Associate Company's strong order book with focus on export orders expected to enhance revenue growth

key_risks: Hormuz crisis creating uncertainty for Fiscal-2027
Trading operations intrinsically linked to crude oil pricing and availability
Supply side constraints may become challenging
Customer outstandings remain a major issue in lubricants trading
Margins under pressure due to stiff competition in lubricants
New PVC pipes business not yet established profitably
Implementation of new Labour Codes may revise salary structure
facts.related_party_note: Company has formulated Policy on Materiality of Related Party transactions and dealing with Related Party transactions as per SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. Policy disclosed on website. Investment in associate Isgec Heavy Engineering Ltd (3,30,84,798 shares, Rs 4057.97 lakhs). No loans/guarantees/security provided under Section 186.
